description.en: Spiral-horned Ilingoceros reconstruction centred on the I. alexandrae horn-core morphotype. No associated complete skeleton is established; body, size, sheath thickness, exact twist and forked tips are interpretive. Species relationships remain unresolved, and the tips are not claimed preserved on the selected type fragment.
description.zh: 以 I. alexandrae 角心形态为中心的螺旋角 Ilingoceros 复原。未证实完整关联骨架；躯体、尺寸、角鞘厚度、具体扭转及分叉角尖为解释性补全。种级关系仍未解决，不声称所选模式残片保存完整角尖。

art_direction.materials: Palette-only opaque Principled materials, metallic 0, restrained roughness around 0.8–0.95; no fur strands or imported photo textures.
art_direction.palette: Restrained muted warm-tan body, slightly lighter belly/inner ears, dark muted-brown horns/hooves, dark eyes/nose. Coat pattern is an artistic choice. Do not reproduce distinctive modern pronghorn black cheek/white neck bands as an asserted fossil marking.
art_direction.priority: Allocate shape detail first to broad twisted horn ridges and small terminal forks, then head, joints and hoof separation.
art_direction.profile: refined-low-poly with deliberate faceted loft topology
art_direction.triangle_target: Approximately 6000–10000 exported triangles; ceiling protects portability, not a demand to spend it.

frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Mammalia, Artiodactyla, Antilocapridae; not a deer and not a tragelaphine bovid.

diagnostic_targets.check: Front, side and perspective show two separated long shafts; one cannot mistake the silhouette for antlers, short pronghorn hooks or curled ram horns.
diagnostic_targets.target: Exactly two dominant long, near-straight horn shafts. Their cross-section/ridges rotate along the axis; do not model an open corkscrew spring or large-radius kudu helix.

diagnostic_targets.check: Ridge progression reads in gray blockout and exact-export perspective. Broad axial ridges must not resemble circumferential stacked rings.
diagnostic_targets.target: Broad helical ridges/grooves are modeled in the horn surface, with substantial continuous volume and nearly rounded cross-sections. Avoid a separate rope wrapped around a straight cylinder.

diagnostic_targets.check: Fork negative spaces remain visible at normal preview scale. Terminal sheath form is labeled inferred, not type-specimen evidence.
diagnostic_targets.target: Restrained terminal bifurcation at each horn tip. Forks are small compared with the main shaft; do not add a large mid-shaft anterior tine, many branches or palmation.

diagnostic_targets.check: The inference is anatomically coherent without pretending that the modern species supplies taxon-specific skeletal proportions. No bulky bovine shoulders, goat beard or deer antlers.
diagnostic_targets.target: A lightly built antilocaprid-like body with four slender but jointed legs, elongated lower segments, cloven hooves, modest neck, elongated muzzle, lateral eyes and short tail.

diagnostic_targets.check: Front/top separate ears, horns and muzzle; side/perspective separate fore- and hindlegs and show grounded weight.
diagnostic_targets.target: Ears sit lateral/posterior to horn bases and remain separate. Hoof pairs and limb silhouettes have readable gaps; shoulder and hip transitions are deliberate, not intersecting unmodified primitives.

diagnostic_targets.check: No claims of exact body mass, coat, locomotor speed, sex, combat behavior, or proven annual sheath shedding for this fossil animal.
diagnostic_targets.target: Keep scientific scope explicit in delivered metadata; genus-level horn-tip reconstruction and comparative body are not evidence of a complete skeleton.

display_name.zh: Ilingoceros alexandrae（螺旋角叉角羚复原）

frozen_scientific_scope.life_stage: Adult-sized horn-bearing form; sex is not assigned from the selected fragment.
frozen_scientific_scope.pose: Quiet alert quadruped. Four split hooves bear weight with a small fore-aft stagger for leg separation. Torso roughly horizontal, neck elevated, muzzle forward and slightly down, short tail down. Horn bases above and behind the eyes, axes rise upward with modest rearward (+Y) and lateral divergence. No rearing, fight, grazing scene, pedestal or environmental props.

presentation_plan.extra_views: None by default; add a horn detail only if four views cannot resolve a concrete question.
presentation_plan.website_reuse: No website-renderer contract is verified during prep. Keep standard QA views; do not imply the preview already meets the website 512 contract or pre-render a 768 wheel image.

prohibited_claims: Exact fossil color or keratin sheath outline
Definitive species split based on the body
Publication or deployment approval from preparation

reference_basis.comparison_excluded: Merriam figure 80 is labeled Ilingoceros form B, not the selected type; Davis and Calède figure 1.1 is I. schizoceras, not a substitute for the long I. alexandrae shaft.
reference_basis.primary_anchor: Merriam 1911, figure 79: type No. 11880, left horn-core base; figure 78a/b: distal fragment No. 11886. These are separate specimens, not one complete pair.
reference_basis.supporting_photo: Davis and Calède 2012, figure 1.2, I. alexandrae horncore. The broken ends must not be mistaken for natural terminal anatomy.

required_evidence: Three or four inexpensive gray blockout views before final rendering, explicitly checking horn ridge topology and terminal forks.
Source and emitted-GLB geometry checks within frozen budgets, genuine Khronos validator result, finite bounds, normals, grounding and material inspection.
Two isolated rebuilds using only copied relative declared dependencies, with semantic geometry/material comparison.
Exact delivered GLB clean-import front, side, top and perspective PNGs. Preview may reuse the perspective bytes. Four original images must be inspected.
Independent visual/factual/specification review bound to the actual GLB and preview hashes. Maker completion does not set independent PASS.
Actual GPU, populated-scene, user and deployed states stay UNKNOWN unless their distinct evidence exists.

scale.status: Illustrative adult pronghorn-sized design envelope; not an Ilingoceros specimen measurement.
scale.tolerance: Up to about 10 percent around design dimensions for coherent stance; preserve a long horn-dominated silhouette. Record intentional changes rather than claiming a fossil measurement.

scientific_limits.en: The reference horncores do not establish a complete living animal. No directly associated postcranial skeleton is demonstrated by the cited Thousand Creek study, and the status of I. alexandrae versus I. schizoceras remains unresolved there. Body proportions, pose, skin, ears, coat and size are illustrative. The keratin sheath and its exact terminal shape are not preserved in the consulted material. The small fork is a genus-level reconstruction, not a claim that the selected type fragment preserves both complete tips. Horn torsion is supported; exact twist count, mirrored pairing and sheath thickness are design choices.
scientific_limits.zh: 参考角心不能确定完整活体；所引 Thousand Creek 研究未证实与角心直接关联的完整躯干及肢体骨架，并未解决 I. alexandrae 与 I. schizoceras 的种级关系。体型比例、姿态、皮肤、耳、毛色及尺寸均为示意推定。所查材料未保存角质鞘及其准确末端形状。小型分叉为属级复原，不声称所选模式残片保存两侧完整角尖。角心扭转有依据；具体圈数、左右镜像及角鞘厚度为造型选择。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original whole-organism low-poly reconstruction centered on the Ilingoceros alexandrae horn-core morphotype from late Miocene Thousand Creek, Nevada. Composite anatomical interpretation, not a fossil scan, a complete associated skeleton, or a measured individual.
